Setup:
1. Enter the tunnel name exactly as it appears in WireGuard.
2. List your home SSIDs.
3. Tap Grant permissions: allow controlling WireGuard tunnels, choose “Allow all the time” for location, and keep system Location on.
4. Tap WireGuard battery settings and set Battery → Unrestricted, otherwise Android refuses to let WireGuard start the VPN in the background.
5. Enable and save.

Samsung phones additionally put apps to sleep: set both this app and WireGuard to Unrestricted and remove them from Sleeping apps.

Older WireGuard builds have no permission prompt; enable “Allow remote control apps” in their settings instead.

On a home SSID the tunnel is brought down; on any other Wi‑Fi or on mobile data it is brought up.
